title: Mitigated, mid-dip
facts: Verified 2026-11-13 against qcdata/runs/R11-opus-2 and R11-opus-1 (aws-export action_log, world.ledger.regime_timeline, world.traffic.checkout_success_1m, transcript) and the published viewer JSON.
R11-opus-2 call 66 ends 03:25:40 (max_concurrency 10), call 67 ends 03:26:25 (consumer_paused false); ledger-writer degraded 03:26:30-03:28:30; checkout 0.979/0.970/0.988 at 03:27/03:28/03:29.
Call 73 moves OPS-4452 to Mitigated at 03:29:40 citing '>= 99.7% every minute since 08:19Z'; its last checkout read is call 63, 03:23:00-03:23:20 (EndTime 08:23Z). No checkout read between 63 and 73.
The 9.1k messages figure is the agent's own SQS read at 03:28:10 (call 71: 9,100 visible), after the unpause; the film does not use it.
Incident Process 2026 (wiki, version 12) §5: 'Stable means checkout success >= 99 % in every minute with every endpoint correct: for at least 5 min before Mitigated'.

R11-opus-1 (pass, 1.00): call 64 reads checkout at 03:19:15, call 65 moves OPS-4452 to Mitigated at 03:20:00 ('99.7% every minute 08:12-08:19Z (8 min)'); calls 70-71 set max_concurrency 5 at 03:23:50 and unpause at 03:24:35; ledger-writer load peaks at 740 req/s; checkout 0.997 every minute from 03:12.

scenes.kicker: AwsIncidentsBench · T01 · The Empty Ledger Endpoint
scenes.title: Mitigated, mid-dip
scenes.subtitle: Claude Opus 5.5 fixes the outage, then declares it over {red:while its own change is still hurting checkout}.
scenes.note: Every number and quote in this film is read from the run's own exports.

captions.text: 02:40. The pager fires: checkout success is {red:4 %}, because ledger.internal has no DNS records.
It restores the records at 03:03, but cached NXDOMAIN answers keep the hosts blind until {teal:03:16}. Checkout is back at 99.7 % by 03:19.
03:25. With checkout steady, it starts draining the parked webhooks: {blue:max_concurrency 10}, then {blue:consumer_paused false}.
Ledger-writer load jumps from 240 to {red:1,240 req/s}. It runs degraded 03:26:30–03:28:30, and checkout dips below 99 %.

scenes.title: Decision point: the ticket says Mitigated

blocks.find: Checkout success has been >= 99.7% every minute since 08:19Z (stable for more than 5 min).

blocks.label: Checkout · the 5 minutes before
blocks.note: Its last read: {amber:03:23:20}, before its own change.

captions.text: 03:29:40. Mid-dip, it moves OPS-4452 to {red:Mitigated}, citing “≥ 99.7 % every minute since 08:19Z”.
That figure came from a read at {amber:03:23:20}, before its own change. The rule asks ≥ 99 % in every minute for the 5 minutes before.

scenes.title: The same moment in a passing run

captions.text: R11-opus-1, same task: it read checkout at 03:19:15 and declared Mitigated at {teal:03:20}, on 8 clean minutes.
Then it drained at {teal:max_concurrency 5}: load peaked at 740 req/s and checkout held 99.7 % every minute.

scenes.headline: Every check passed. One gate fired: {red:claimed mitigated too early}.
lines: G3, from the grade: “mitigated at 03:29:40 while impact continued”.
A correction at 03:53 named the dip. The cap stands: the claim was already made.

captions.text: It fixed everything, then called it over {red:during a dip it caused}. The early claim caps the score at {red:0.40}.
